variants.headline: The Perfect Hand-Poured Gift From Vermont
variants.body: Delight them with our premium hand-poured soy candles, presented in elegant, gift-ready packaging. Crafted in small batches in Vermont with zero synthetic fragrances, these sets make a lasting impression. Fast, reliable shipping options ensure your thoughtful gift arrives right on time.
variants.rationale: This copy highlights premium presentation, gift-ready packaging, and fast shipping, satisfying the Gifter's need for an impressive, timely present.

variants.headline: 100% Natural Soy Wax Candles, Hand-Poured in Vermont
variants.body: Our candles are crafted in small, traceable batches in Vermont using only 100% natural soy wax and zero synthetic fragrances. By keeping our ingredient list minimal and sourcing transparently, we ensure a clean, plant-based burn that respects the environment.
variants.rationale: It appeals to the sustainability buyer by focusing on traceable Vermont sourcing, a 100% natural soy wax ingredient claim, and zero synthetic fragrances.

variants.headline: Quiet Luxury: Hand-Poured Vermont Soy Candles
variants.body: Experience the understated elegance of candles poured individually by hand in Vermont. Crafted in small, disciplined batches with premium natural soy wax and no synthetic fragrances, they offer a clean, enduring burn. A timeless addition to any home that values true craftsmanship.
variants.rationale: Emphasizes traditional craftsmanship, small-batch heritage, and understated elegance, avoiding trendy buzzwords.

variants.headline: Optimize Your Indoor Air: Zero Synthetic Fragrances
variants.body: Support a clean home environment with our hand-poured Vermont soy candles. Made with 100% natural soy wax and completely free from synthetic fragrances, they eliminate unwanted airborne toxins from your space, ensuring your breathing environment remains pure and optimized.
variants.rationale: Focuses on optimizing the indoor breathing environment with transparent, clean ingredient claims (100% natural soy, zero synthetics).
